snippet.title: LYSA HORA: The Haunted Hill - Trailer 4K
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3963490/LYSA_HORA_The_Haunted_Hill

Special thanks to Ariadna - https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC65iidaw3abl35I2ZAvv_lw
for Безодня music

Special thanks to https://www.youtube.com/@UCcXkG1K4LFasc-i-_pfOymA  for video in the game

Game by former Lead Level Designer of S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2

A dark sci-fi horror where ancient rituals intertwine with Soviet experiments. With a strong focus on atmosphere, uncover a forbidden place inspired by a real location, through fortress tunnels, hidden laboratories, and ancient shrines.

You are a college student who has just moved to a large city in search of a new life. But instead of a fresh start, you begin to suffer from recurring nightmares. In your dreams, you see a mysterious hill. It’s calling you.
Each night the visions grow more vivid: underground tunnels, abandoned structures, and a strange device that once kept something contained.
Trying to understand what’s happening, you uncover classified documents hidden in the city archives. What you discover leaves you with only one choice — go to the hill yourself.
The only way to end the nightmares is to reach their source. But not everything buried underground should be awakened.
